conflicts.description: Calculated M_S temperature (Table 1) vs. measured M_S temperature (Gleeble dilatometry). Calculated values are 294 °C (AM1), 281 °C (AM2), 312 °C (AM3); measured values are 276 °C (AM1), 280 °C (AM2), 293 °C (AM3). The measured value is consistent with calculation only for AM2; AM1 and AM3 measured M_S are approximately 19 °C lower than calculated.

evidence.quote: The measured M S temperature is consistent with the calculated M S temperature of AM2 in Table 1 , while they are approximately 19 ◦ C lower than the calculated M S temperature of AM1 and AM3.
